is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles gambiae sensu lato (including An. gambiae s.s. M and S molecular forms, and An. arabiensis) collected across Burkina Faso, Chad, and Sudan (page 1, 4-5).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study conducts WHO tube bioassays and species/molecular form identification by PCR-RFLP (Fanello et al.), but does not genotype any insecticide resistance target-site markers (such as Vgsc kdr or Ace-1); kdr and ace-1 are only referenced from previous literature in the discussion.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No resistance marker genotype or allele data are reported; only species/form identification frequencies and bioassay mortality percentages are presented.

african_field_population.evidence: Field-collected larvae reared to adults from 12 sentinel sites across Burkina Faso, Chad, and Sudan in 2008-2009 (pages 3-4).

is_primary_study.evidence: Presents primary empirical bioassay data from year one of the WHO/TDR multi-country network (page 1).

sub_country_location.evidence: Specific sentinel sites with geographic coordinates are provided: Kuinima, Soumousso, Koupela, and Goundry in Burkina Faso; N'Djamena, Donia, Bongor, and Mandelia in Chad; Wad Medani, El Managil, Wad El Hadad, and Rofaa in Sudan (pages 3-4).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections occurred across two rounds between July 2008 and January 2009 (pages 3-4).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Primary reporting of the 2008-2009 sentinel site bioassay surveillance network funded by WHO/TDR.

supplement.evidence: No supplementary files are indicated as containing missing resistance marker genotype data.

assessment.summary: This study reports WHO susceptibility tube bioassay results and Anopheles gambiae complex species/form identification from 12 sentinel sites in Burkina Faso, Chad, and Sudan sampled between 2008 and 2009. No target insecticide resistance markers (such as kdr or ace-1) were genotyped.
exclusion_reasons: Does not genotype any of the target insecticide resistance markers (bioassays and species identification only).
